interpretation: Three synchronous SetData markers returned positive GPU timestamp intervals; one/two 8MiB buffers and a CPU delay outside the marker are single observations, not average bandwidth or model load latency.
Data was compared outside GPU timing markers; the Dispose case was verified before disposal.
Dispose returned on CPU, but its GPU timestamp evidence was absent across 711 distinct render frames. Missing timing is not zero GPU work and not proof that driver retirement completed.
The invocation label green denotes implementation attempt, not test success: it ended 0 pass / 1 fail / skip0 / exit2.
The failing positive-GPU gate was not relaxed. Existing model load/release metrics remain null; no real model or minimum-memory qualification is claimed.
Windows exposes GPU Engine Running Time counters locally. This is only a candidate for a separate calibrated process/engine observation; no load/release values were captured with it here.
